{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/tasks/aluminum_melting_trial_1/in.melt","content":"# LAMMPS input script for melting aluminum

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data aluminum_data.lmp

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10

# NVT Equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
thermo 100
run 10000

# NPT Relaxation
unfix 1
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000

# NPT Heating
unfix 1
fix 1 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000

# Output final density
variable rho equal mass(all)/vol(all)
print "Final density: ${rho} g/cm^3""}
